original_txt: Implementing Control Panel Items (Windows) | Microsoft Docs Skip to main content Contents Exit focus mode Share Twitter LinkedIn Facebook Email Theme Light Dark High contrast Sign in Profile Sign out Contents Implementing Control Panel Items 04/30/2018 2 minutes to read In this article Control Panel items are DLLs or executable (.exe) files that let users configure the environment of Windows. They are typically accessed by clicking an icon in the Control Panel. This section describes Control Panel items and explains how to create and register them so that they appear appropriately in the Control Panel. For Windows\xc2 Vista, information is included that tells you how to add task links that appear under the Control Panel item and in Control Panel search results.
